title: Auto Formisch Form Definition, version 1
description: A Form Definition in format version 1. The loader in `@auto-formisch/core` is the one judge of a Definition; this schema gives editors autocomplete and catches most mistakes, but not all: it cannot compare names across the tree, resolve Condition references or apply a Field's own Rules to its `default`, and it takes any other `type` or Rule name as one the application registers.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema of this Definition, for editors. Ignored by the loader.

version.description: The format version of this Definition.

components.description: The Components of a single-page form.

pages.description: The Pages of a Wizard: at least one, and only `page`.

name.description: The Field's key in the submitted data: letters, digits and _, not starting with a digit. Unique among the Fields of its data scope, through every Layout.

label.description: The text that names this Component to the person filling in the form.

description.description: Help text shown with this Component.

placeholder.description: Hint text shown in an empty control.

widget.description: The name of the Widget that presents this Component. Presentation only: it never changes validation. Defaults to the `type`; the Renderer checks the name.

requiredMessage.description: The error shown when this required Field is left empty.

columns.description: Lays the direct children out in this many grid columns.

colSpan.description: How many of its parent's `columns` this Component spans. Only inside a parent with `columns`, and no wider than them.

noColSpan.description: A Component outside a grid takes no `colSpan`.

filledString.description: A string with at least one character that is not whitespace.

choiceValue.description: A choice value: a non-empty string or a number.

visible.description: Shows this Component only while the Condition holds. A hidden Field is Inactive: not validated and not submitted.

disabled.description: Disables this Field, always (`true`) or while the Condition holds. A disabled Field is Inactive: not validated and not submitted.

required.description: Whether this Field must be answered: always (`true`) or while the Condition holds. Fields are optional by default.

condition.description: A Condition: one of `all`, `any` and `not`, or a leaf `{field, operator, value?}`, nested at most 8 levels, leaves included.

any.description: True when at least one Condition is.

not.description: True when the Condition is not.

any.description: True when at least one Condition is.

not.description: True when the Condition is not.

any.description: True when at least one Condition is.

not.description: True when the Condition is not.

any.description: True when at least one Condition is.

not.description: True when the Condition is not.

any.description: True when at least one Condition is.

not.description: True when the Condition is not.

any.description: True when at least one Condition is.

not.description: True when the Condition is not.

any.description: True when at least one Condition is.

not.description: True when the Condition is not.

condition8.description: At the 8th level a Condition is a leaf.

conditionLeaf.description: Compares the value of one Field with a literal. An Inactive Field reads as empty.

field.description: The Field to read, from the data scope of this Component: `../` steps, then names joined by `.`.

operator.description: Which operators apply depends on the Field: `eq`, `neq`, `in`, `not_in` (text, choice, number, date), `eq`, `neq` (boolean), `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte` (number, date), `contains` (multi_choice), `empty`, `not_empty` (every Field but `object`).

value.description: A literal of the Field's type; a non-empty list for `in` and `not_in`; none for `empty` and `not_empty`.

requirement.description: The Rule's limit, for Rules that take one.

message.description: The error shown when the Rule fails, instead of the default.

customRule.description: A Rule the application registers with `defineRule`, on a value Field. The JSON Schema describes only the built-in Rules, so it takes any other name and `requirement`; loading the Definition rejects a Rule that is not registered or does not apply to the Field.

textRules.description: The Rules of a "text" Field, checked in order on a value that is not empty.

anyOf.description: The value is an email address.
The value is an absolute URL.
The text has at least `requirement` characters.
The text has at most `requirement` characters.

numberRules.description: The Rules of a "number" Field, checked in order on a value that is not empty.

anyOf.description: The value is at least `requirement`.
The value is at most `requirement`.
The number is a whole number.

dateRules.description: The Rules of a "date" Field, checked in order on a value that is not empty.

anyOf.description: The value is at least `requirement`.
The value is at most `requirement`.

booleanRules.description: The Rules of a "boolean" Field, checked in order on a value that is not empty.

anyOf.description: The box is checked.

choiceRules.description: The Rules of a "choice" Field, checked in order on a value that is not empty.

multiChoiceRules.description: The Rules of a "multi_choice" Field, checked in order on a value that is not empty.

anyOf.description: At least `requirement` items or rows.
At most `requirement` items or rows.

repeaterRules.description: The Rules of a "repeater" Field, on its list of rows. Custom Rules apply only to value Fields, not here.

anyOf.description: At least `requirement` items or rows.
At most `requirement` items or rows.

choices.description: The values to pick from: strings or numbers, never both, as plain values or `{value, label?}`. At least one, and no value twice.

label.description: The text shown for this choice.
The text shown for this choice.

default.description: The value a new form starts with. Not empty, of the Field's type, and through its Rules.

numberField.description: A Field holding a finite number.

type.description: A Field holding a finite number.

default.description: The value a new form starts with. Not empty, of the Field's type, and through its Rules.

booleanField.description: A Field holding true or false.

type.description: A Field holding true or false.

default.description: The value a new form starts with. Not empty, of the Field's type, and through its Rules.

choiceField.description: A Field holding one value of its `choices`.

type.description: A Field holding one value of its `choices`.

default.description: The value a new form starts with. Not empty, of the Field's type, and through its Rules.

multiChoiceField.description: A Field holding a list of values of its `choices`.

type.description: A Field holding a list of values of its `choices`.

default.description: The value a new form starts with. Not empty, of the Field's type, and through its Rules.

dateField.description: A Field holding a calendar date as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

type.description: A Field holding a calendar date as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

default.description: The value a new form starts with. Not empty, of the Field's type, and through its Rules.

objectField.description: A Field holding an object of its child Fields: a data scope of its own. It always submits `{}` at least.

type.description: A Field holding an object of its child Fields.

repeaterField.description: A Field holding a list of rows, each an object following the template in `components`. It always submits `[]` at least.

type.description: A Field holding a list of rows.

default.description: The rows a new form starts with: at least one, each an object of the template's Fields.

section.description: A Layout grouping Components, with an optional heading. It adds no data path.

tabs.description: A Layout showing one `tab` at a time. It adds no data path.

type.description: A Layout showing one `tab` at a time.

components.description: The Tabs: at least one, and only `tab`.

tab.description: One Tab of a `tabs`; it sits only there. It adds no data path.

label.description: The Tab's name, on its button.

page.description: One step of a Wizard; it sits only in the root `pages`. All Pages share the root data scope.

content.description: Plain text shown in the form. It holds no value; HTML is shown as text.

type.description: Plain text shown in the form.

text.description: The text, shown as plain text.

customField.description: A Field of a Field Type the application registers with `defineFieldType`. The JSON Schema describes only the built-in types, so it takes any other name and its options; loading the Definition rejects a type that is not registered, or options it does not take.

rules.description: A custom Field Type takes no `rules`; its constraints are in its options.

component.description: A Component: a Field, a Layout or Content, by its `type`.

type.description: What the Component is. `type` describes data; `widget` describes presentation.

anyOf.description: A Field holding a string.
A Field holding a finite number.
A Field holding true or false.
A Field holding one value of its `choices`.
A Field holding a list of values of its `choices`.
A Field holding a calendar date as `YYYY-MM-DD`.
A Field holding an object of its child Fields: a data scope of its own. It always submits `{}` at least.
A Field holding a list of rows, each an object following the template in `components`. It always submits `[]` at least.
A Layout grouping Components, with an optional heading. It adds no data path.
A Layout showing one `tab` at a time. It adds no data path.
Plain text shown in the form. It holds no value; HTML is shown as text.

type.description: A `tab` goes directly inside `tabs`, and a `page` directly inside the root `pages`.

gridComponents.description: Components in a grid: each may take `colSpan`.
